```yaml
name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency: deploy

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Increment version
      id: increment_version
      run: |
        if [ ! -f "_includes/VERSION.txt" ]; then
          echo "::error::VERSION.txt not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        CURRENT_VERSION=$(cat _includes/VERSION.txt)
        NEW_VERSION=$((CURRENT_VERSION + 1))
        echo "New version: $NEW_VERSION"
        echo "$NEW_VERSION" > _includes/VERSION.txt
        git add _includes/VERSION.txt
        git commit -m "chore: bump version to $NEW_VERSION"

    - name: Create Git tag
      run: git tag v$NEW_VERSION

    - name: Check for duplicate tags
      run: |
        if git show-ref --tags | grep -q "refs/tags/v$NEW_VERSION"; then
          echo "::error::Duplicate tag v$NEW_VERSION found"
          exit 1
        fi

    - name: Build Jekyll site
      run: npm run build

    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./_site
        cname: testingconferences.github.io
```
